args.title: Fix: re-raise exceptions in get_or_compute instead of silently returning stale value
args.body:
## Problem
`get_or_compute` was silently swallowing exceptions from the `compute` function and returning the previous cached value (`_last`). This caused dashboards to show stale data during outages with no visible error trace.

## Root Cause
In `src/cache.py`, the `except Exception` block returned `_last` instead of propagating the error:
```python
except Exception:
    return _last   # BUG: swallows the error silently
```

## Fix
Changed the except block to re-raise the exception:
```python
except Exception:
    raise
```

This ensures callers see the real failure immediately, making outages diagnosable.

## Tests
- `tests/test_cache.py::test_compute_failure_contract` — now passes (verifies `ValueError` is raised)
- `tests/test_cache.py::test_returns_computed_value` — continues to pass (normal path unaffected)
